title: Report filtering: select a customer and explain every minute
goal: Reconcile a customer-reference filter against own requests while retaining all other records.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a6; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: The question determines parameters
paragraphs: The starter report offers a Клиент filter; period/status are not ready-made quick settings. Do not search for absent controls. Selecting a reference answers “Alpha requests”; “closed requests this month” requires a different schema/change, handled in the last lesson.

sections.title: Own control set
paragraphs: Follow the scoped native application route; diagrams are not executable browser code.

code.output: Alpha reference 2/75, Beta 1/15; older records retained.

sections.title: Resources have units
paragraphs: Create two of your own customers, Учебный A7 — Альфа and Учебный A7 — Бета, one service and three requests: 30 and 45 minutes for Alpha, 15 minutes for Beta. Write down their actual codes and document numbers. First record the existing overall total T0. The new documents add three requests and 90 minutes; older documents remain in the infobase. Alpha filtering must show two requests totaling 75 minutes; Beta filtering must show one request for 15 minutes.

sections.title: Filters can act at different levels
paragraphs: Количество counts documents and Минуты sums their ДлительностьМинут, not service cost. Choose by card/code: another equal-named customer without requests yields an empty set. Name text is not a reference. Reconcile source numbers and the selected identity before altering any formula.

sections.title: Same name, different identity
paragraphs: Compare a distinct negative case while preserving accepted work.

code.source: A different equal-named customer without requests is selected.
code.output: Empty; the original Alpha requests still exist.

tables.caption: Step-by-step reasoning

sections.title: Detect wrong parameters
paragraphs: Use Настройки, locate Клиент, enable its filter, select the own customer, finish settings and click Сформировать. Disabling the filter restores the overall set without deleting records. An empty selection does not mean the entire base is empty. Regenerate for Alpha, Beta and disabled filtering.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: The entire report is expected to total 90 despite older work. Compare the T0 increment or selected customer without deleting old records.
Absent period/status controls are assumed to exist. Use Клиент and specify missing functionality as a change.
An equal name selects another reference. Open the card and compare its actual customer code.

selfcheck.prompt: Explain equal names and the period/status requirement without claiming absent controls.
selfcheck.feedback: Identity separated from name; missing behavior specified separately.

practice.title: Report filtering: select a customer and explain every minute
practice.task: Explain equal names and the period/status requirement without claiming absent controls.
practice.environment: Own continuing service-desk copy; no real data. Studio/Sandbox optional.
practice.externalRoute: Official installed Enterprise and own study notes

steps.title: Record the initial total
steps.where: Enterprise → Учебная служба → Отчёты → Заявки по клиентам
steps.action: Disable Клиент, generate and record T0/count. Retain old documents.
steps.expected: Initial total and document count recorded.
steps.troubleshooting: If this report is absent, check that this is your own service-desk configuration from earlier lessons.
steps.before: A6 work and source provenance retained; actual own infobase identified.

steps.title: Save your control set
steps.action: Create own Alpha/Beta/service; save 30/45 for Alpha and 15 for Beta with Новая. Record codes/numbers.
steps.expected: Your three requests are saved: two for Alpha and one for Beta.
steps.troubleshooting: If a request is missing, reopen its form and confirm it was saved with the intended customer.
steps.before: Initial total and document count recorded.

steps.title: Choose the actual Alpha
steps.action: Enable Клиент, select Alpha by card/code, finish settings and generate.
steps.expected: Alpha: two actual requests totaling 75 minutes.
steps.troubleshooting: If Alpha produces no rows, compare the selected customer code with the saved request; a same-name customer may have a different reference.
steps.before: Your three requests are saved: two for Alpha and one for Beta.

steps.title: Switch the filter
steps.action: Select Beta and generate 1/15. Disable filtering and regenerate overall results: increment 3/90 over T0.
steps.expected: Beta: one request for 15 minutes; disabling the filter adds three requests and 90 minutes relative to the baseline.
steps.troubleshooting: If Beta still shows Alpha, confirm the filter value and click Generate (Сформировать) again.
steps.before: Alpha: two actual requests totaling 75 minutes.

steps.title: Retain parameters and keys
steps.action: Record actual codes/numbers, filter state and totals, not just a screenshot of one sum.
steps.expected: Each total links to actual source requests and the chosen customer reference.
steps.troubleshooting: Record the filter state with document numbers so another person can reproduce the result.
steps.before: Beta: one request for 15 minutes; disabling the filter adds three requests and 90 minutes relative to the baseline.
